audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, youthful male voice (a child) singing a melodic line in Mandarin. The vocal delivery is slightly unstable in pitch but energetic. A soft acoustic guitar BGM provides a steady, mid-tempo rhythmic foundation. The environment sounds like a quiet room with minimal ambient noise. (2) A sharp, digital "pop" sound effect triggers a transition. The boy attempts a high melodic leap, resulting in vocal strain and a slight crack in his voice. The BGM continues unchanged. The vocal intensity increases as he tries to reach the higher notes, followed by a brief moment of artificial silence. (3) A comical, rising "boing" sound effect occurs as the boy lets out a loud, high-arousal shout of frustration that transitions into genuine laughter. An off-screen female voice joins in with clear, moderate-volume laughter. The BGM remains as a gentle background bed under the sudden burst of vocal noise. (4) The audio undergoes a major transition to a high-fidelity, studio-recorded female vocal track. This voice is clear, professional, and well-enunciated, singing the same melody. The BGM swells with added synthesized strings and a clearer piano texture. The child's voice is no longer present, replaced by the clean musical production.
